items.title: China prepares £40bn stimulus for financial sector amid fears over sluggish growth

sentences.en: A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly.
sentences.zh: 许多金融机构表示，他们将从包括财政部甚至经营该国烟草垄断的公司在内的国家机构获得数十亿元人民币的资本。

sentences.zh: 周日，来自Anak Krakatau的火山灰云影响了数百次航班，印尼的一些学校和钓鱼活动停止了8个机场的运营，包括其主要国际枢纽，由于Anak Krakatau火山的火山灰云影响了数百次航班。
